instruction: Enable GlusterFS bitrot detection on a volume
Disable GlusterFS bitrot detection on a volume

output: gluster volume snapshot create snap1 gvol1

instruction: Restore a GlusterFS volume from snapshot
output: gluster volume snapshot restore gvol1 snap1

instruction: Set up GlusterFS geo-replication on a volume
output: gluster volume geo-replication gvol1 root@remote-host::gvol2 create
gluster volume geo-replication gvol1 root@remote-host::gvol2 start
gluster volume geo-replication gvol1 root@remote-host::gvol2 stop

Mount a GlusterFS volume with backup servers
